work.name: IKEA North America Services, LLC
highlights: Co-owned the transition of the Product Information Page’s availability and services to a DWF fragment under the Buy Experience team; built and operated server- and client-rendered microfrontends on IKEA’s edge-rendering platform (EVS), while leading localized translation architecture and implementation, SSR availability loading, and CI/CD work for the fragments

Managed edge caching, request context, and production/test deployments for independently delivered fragments, resolving cross-fragment state, SSR, and pub/sub integration issues across Cloudflare Workers

Co-designed the Buy Experience team monorepo migration CLI and CI/CD pattern, consolidating 52 per-market production deployments into one deployment per release and personally drove adoption by the Navigation team

Diagnosed and fixed geolocation reliability and data-integrity issues, including an 11% reduction so far in Google Geocoding API cost, a customer-visible validation regression affecting 27 markets, and cross-user SSR state leakage

Drove development of Vaka, a greenfield, real-time observability platform built with Fastly, Dynamic Web Framework, Preact, GCP, and MongoDB that enhanced error resolution in customer-facing online shopping systems, significantly reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
Modernized checkout foundations owned by the Buy Experience team through ESLint, our internal design system components, Renovate, security, and TypeScript upgrades across several repositories
